svg.title: BH keeps every gene up to rank 94
svg.desc: The 200 smallest Hedenfalk p-values with the Bonferroni, BH and Storey lines; rank 94 is the last under BH's line.

text.tspan: BH keeps every gene up to rank 94
Sort the 3,170 p-values. BH finds the largest rank k with p(k) ≤ k × 0.05 / 3,170,
then rejects ranks 1 to k. Storey's line is the same, divided by π0.

svg.text: Bonferroni and Holm stop at rank 2

text.tspan: BH's threshold at rank k is k times Bonferroni's: 94 genes instead of 2.
